act_name: Civil Services (Qualification for appointment as High Court Judge) Act, 1965
heading: Short title and commencement
title: Short title and commencement
text:
1. Short title and commencement.—(1). This Act may be called the Civil Services (Qualification for Appointment as High Court Judge) Act, 1965.

(2) It shall come into force at once.

act_name: Civil Services (Qualification for appointment as High Court Judge) Act, 1965
heading: Certain Groups of APUG to be civil service for purposes of Article 193 (2) (b) of the Constitution
title: 2[Certain Groups of APUG] to be civil service for purposes of 3[Article 193] (2) (b) of
text:
2. Certain Groups of APUG to be civil service for purposes of Article 193 (2) (b) of the Constitution. The Secretariat Group and District Management Group of the All-Pakistan Unified Grades, and the successors of the said Groups from time to time, shall be a Civil Service for the purposes of paragraph (b) of clause (2) of article 193 of the constitution.

1For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1965, Ext., p.1348.
2 Subs. by the Civil Services (Qualification for Appointment as High Court Judge) (Amdt.) Act 1988 (I of 1988), s.2 for “CSP”.
3Subs. by F.A.O. 1975, Art.2 and Sch. for “Article 92”.
4Subs. by Act 1 of 1988, s. 2, for “Civil Service of Pakistan”.
